title: fix(runtime)!: a package export refuses when the read of a type the runtime serves fails, naming the package and the type
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8RrcHdcT2sd8bmMYxRsSsjw)_
Fixes #29760

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the skills and docs teach what a package export carries, never how it fails; the refusal is a retryable server answer whose message names the type, and nothing a metadata author writes is read differently.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`assemblePackageManifest`(`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`)逐类型读取的 `catch` 不再一律当「未知类型」跳过。只有运行时实时类型表(`getMetaTypes`)里没有的类型照旧跳过;运行时服务的类型读取失败,则拒绝整个导出,消息点名包与类型,并沿用读取错误自带的 status/code(实测存储故障为 `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`,未声明的抛错为 `500`)。整库导出 `GET /packages/export` 组合同一生产者,随之拒绝,无第二处检查。
- 为什么改:改前读取失败时 `GET /packages/:id/export` 照样答 200,只是少了整个集合(实测 showcase 少了 `dashboards`),据此重装会静默丢掉该类型,违背导出权承诺与 bundle 的「要么完整、要么没有」。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING 横幅):原本答 200 的残缺导出现在是 5xx 拒绝。读取成功时导出逐字节不变;没有 `getMetaTypes` 或类型表读不出来时按「已服务」处理(失败即拒绝,fail closed)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages.ts` 的 `runtimeServesMetadataType` 与 `packageExportTypeReadRefusal`(判定与拒绝的构造);② 逐类型循环里改写后的 `catch`;③ dogfood `package-export-type-read-failure.dogfood.test.ts` 的注入点(协议自身的 `readActiveOverlayRows`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-export-type-read-failure.test.ts`,预期 10/10 通过;撤掉修复后 8 条转红(读到的是 200 而非拒绝)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Clause-② 收窄,席位先做 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核)。

## What changes

- **`assemblePackageManifest`'s per-type `catch`** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`). It caught every failure of `getMetaItemsPerPackage` / `getMetaItems` as "unknown/unsupported type for this runtime" and skipped the type. Now, after a read throws, it asks one question: does this runtime serve the type?
  - **No** (the type is absent from the live type vocabulary, `getMetaTypes`, the one accessor that answers "which types exist here" for the `/meta` listing too): skipped, as before.
  - **Yes**: the export is refused. `packageExportTypeReadRefusal` builds the error: the message names the package and the type (`Reading the 'dashboard' items of package 'P' failed, so its export is refused rather than answered without them`), the read's own declared `status` / `statusCode` and string `code` ride on unchanged, and the read's error stays on `cause`. The read's sentence is quoted only when it is a declared client refusal (`clientFacingFailureText`, the existing ADR-0112 disclosure decision this file already imports).
  - **Fail closed**: a protocol that brings no `getMetaTypes`, or whose listing throws, has not shown the type unknown, so its failed read refuses too. The listing is asked only after a read threw; a successful export never calls it.
- **Status family, no new code.** The per-package route's existing `catch` answers `errorFromThrown(e, 500)`, so the refusal is the read's declared status and code, or `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` for an undeclared throw. Measured on the real protocol: a failed overlay read is rethrown as a declared `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, and the export answers exactly that.
- **The bundle.** `GET /packages/export` (#29755) composes `assemblePackageManifest` and already turns a throw into a refusal naming the package. So it refuses through the per-package path, naming the package and the type, with no second check in the bundle (the one-producer rule).
- **`PackagesDomainProtocol`** picks `getMetaTypes` from the declared `MetadataProtocol` contract, beside the three it already picked. No `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and no spec file is touched.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/runtime` patch, `fix(runtime)!:` with the BREAKING banner, both declaration lines and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

- **New unit file** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-type-read-failure.test.ts` (real dispatcher, protocol double), 10 cases:
  - per-package export: undeclared throw → `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` naming package and type, the throw's sentence not quoted; declared `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` carried; a declared `400 INVALID_REQUEST`'s sentence quoted after the package and the type; CONTROL a type the vocabulary does not list still skipped, the rest answered 200; fail closed with no `getMetaTypes` and with a throwing listing; CONTROL the listing is not asked when no read throws;
  - bundle: declared `503` and undeclared `500` refuse `GET /packages/export`, naming package and type, no body; CONTROL an unserved type leaves the bundle 200 with the entry.
- **New dogfood file** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-type-read-failure.dogfood.test.ts`, one showcase boot with the install-local plugin and one installed package, the fault injected on the real protocol's own overlay read (`readActiveOverlayRows`), 5 cases: CONTROL both doors 200 with dashboards; a failed `dashboard` read refuses `GET /packages/com.example.showcase/export` `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` naming both, no manifest; the same refuses `GET /packages/export` naming the installed package and `dashboard`, no bundle; CONTROL restored, both 200 again; an unserved type (`rag_pipeline`, asserted absent from the boot's live vocabulary) still skipped, both doors 200 with the same collections.

<details><summary>Red first, before the fix</summary>

- Unit, on `origin/main` `7ba8b11f` (the fix's source restored from the base): 6 of 7 failed, every one reading `200` (`{"success":true,"data":{"objects":[…],"id":"com.example.ledger",…}}`, no `dashboards`). The seventh, the no-throw CONTROL, passed.
- Unit, after merging `origin/main` with #29755 (`b3d14150`), the fix commit reverse-applied in the tree: 8 of 10 failed, the two bundle refusal cases among them (bundle `200`).
- Dogfood, the runtime rebuilt without the fix (`ablation-dist-preflight` proved the marker absent from `packages/runtime/dist`; restore leg rebuilt and proved it present, tree clean): the refusal case failed with `expected 200 to be 503`; the body carried 20 collections and no `dashboards` key.
</details>

<details><summary>Green, on the final head `4378aebe`</summary>

- Unit: `packages-export-type-read-failure.test.ts`, `packages-export-bundle.test.ts`, `packages-export-per-package-layer.test.ts`: 3 files, 23/23.
- Dogfood file: 5/5.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (pre-merge head `cac7e010`): 534 files passed, 8547 passed, 19 skipped. On the final head `4378aebe`, after merging `origin/main` (#29755 touches the same function): 535 files passed, 8564 passed, 19 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. Re-run on `4378aebe`: runtime typecheck exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, the narrowing arm): `4378aebe` · lock VERDICT command-exit 0, held 1851 s · Test Files 405 passed, 3 skipped (408) · Tests 3331 passed, 28 skipped (3359) · no failure.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The unknown arm on a real boot.** Measured on the showcase: 30 types are exportable and the live vocabulary lists 37; exactly one exportable type is absent, `rag_pipeline`. That is the only type whose failed read a real showcase still skips; every other per-type failure now refuses. A protocol double without the type, or without `getMetaTypes` at all, is the other place the arm is reachable.
- **Why the vocabulary, and not the error's shape.** The real protocol never throws for a type it does not know (an empty registry slot answers `[]`, and an unsupported metadata-service loader is caught inside the protocol), so no error shape marks "unknown type". Asking the runtime's own type listing, only after a throw, is the one authority available without `protocol.ts` (frozen).
- **Message disclosure.** The sentence names the package and the type in every case; the read's own text is appended only for a declared 4xx (`clientFacingFailureText`), so a driver dump never reaches the wire through it and the dispatcher's 5xx withhold never swallows the package and type names.
- **Out of scope, noted.** `ownDocumentsOf`'s `catch` around `registry.getArtifactItem` and the `registry.getPackage` lookup's `catch` in the same function still answer `undefined` on a throw; neither drops a collection (the first keeps the layer's items, the second only loses the label/namespace lookup). Read-only inference; carrier: none.
- **Commit identity.** Commits carry the model-free trailer pair; the harness's attribution reminder names a model in its `Co-Authored-By` line, which the pre-push hook refuses, so the AGENTS.md form was used.
- **Reviewers.** The dev requested none.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this diff (merge base `b3d14150`, head `4378aebe`, 4 paths, +452 / -4): 63 commands, all run, every exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its closure build queued behind this PR's own dogfood battery on the shared lock and timed out, nothing measured); re-run under the lock, exit 0 (0 ledger entries above their recorded numbers).
- `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The same 63 on the pre-merge head `cac7e010`: 61 exit 0 at first; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (its pinned positive-control commit was outside the shallow clone; fetched, re-run exit 0) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, unrelated packages had no `dist/`; exit 0 on the final head).
